title: A transcript with your own dictionary
description: Adding your working terms and names, checking the doubtful spots and keeping the corrections.

blocks.text: A student or a specialist brings in a recording full of recurring names and terms. They set up a dictionary, see the doubtful spots and check them against the audio; the corrections are saved together with the transcript.

quote.text: The issue is with complex lecture material (4+ year engineering student). The notes are basically worthless because the complex terms are not transcribed correctly.

blocks.text: Not fixing the same term ten times

You could start with one subject and the real recordings of its audience. Reusing a confirmed spelling of a name helps, but similar words should not be replaced everywhere without looking at the context.
What to test on your own material

The main result is less repeated proofreading while the ability to check a phrase is preserved. The review about wrong technical terms confirms the problem; it does not prove that adding a dictionary will automatically remove every recognition error.
